mentions.name: 3D-printable lattice isosurface extractor
mentions.description: This tool implements a specialized isosurface extraction algorithm for generating 3D-printable surface-based lattices. The lattice configuration is derived from a conventional triangle mesh that can be prepared in any STL editor, and the lattice shape comes from a precalculated Fourier polynomial in barycentric coordinates.
